1.title: Parsec is being restarted on the host computer
1.desc: Try connecting again in a few seconds.

3.desc: The host OS closed the Parsec application due to a login/logout event, please reconnect.

5.desc: You have been kicked by the host.

6.title: Your connection attempt wasn't approved in time
6.desc: The host needs to approve your connection for you to join.

8.title: Your connection attempt was rejected
8.desc: The host declined your request or blocked you.

11.title: The computer you tried to join is full
11.desc: Wait for a free slot or ask the host to increase the number of slots.

12.desc: You were disconnected from the host due to inactivity.

13.desc: You were disconnected from the host due to the owner's disconnection.

14.title: Your connection is not allowed
14.desc: The host you are connecting to has Privacy Mode enabled, but the prerequisite Parsec Virtual Display Driver is either not installed or not working correctly.

15.title: The host computer went to sleep
15.desc: The host computer you were connected to went to sleep and has closed the connection.

30.label: Download
30.title: Your browser can not make connections in the web app
30.desc: The Parsec web app only works in recent versions of Chrome and Edge, please use one of these browsers or install the Parsec app on your client to continue.

99.title: The computer you're connecting to is no longer available
99.desc: Check if the machine is online, get a new link if applicable, or try to restart Parsec on both ends.

101.title: Multi-factor authentication is required
101.desc: Your team requires that you enable multi-factor authentication before making connections.

102.title: You cannot connect to this computer.
102.desc: Your email domain has been verified as belonging to a 'Parsec for Teams' account. You will not be able to make connections from this domain using personal accounts. Please reach out to your internal IT team for access.

112.title: You don't have the permission to connect to this computer
112.desc: You're not in the same Parsec Teams group as the computer you're attempting to connect to.

-10.title: Parsec couldn't find a compatible video decoder
-10.desc: Please check our article for more information.

-14.title: Your device failed to decode the video stream
-14.desc: Please check our article for more information.

-18.title: Your device had issues decoding the video stream
-18.desc: This device may be incompatible with Parsec, please check our article for more information.

-19.title: Your device isn't supported by Parsec
-19.desc: This Android device does not work with Parsec currently.

-1002.title: You don't have access to a host computer
-1002.desc: Running Parsec in CLI mode requires that you enable hosting on a Windows machine.

-1003.title: Parsec does not have sufficient permissions on this device
-1003.desc: Parsec was unable to write required data to your device.

-2001.title: You do not have permission to make this connection
-2001.desc: You can't connect with this peer_id.

-3010.title: Your Teams subscription expired
-3010.desc: Resume the subscription in the Teams Admin Panel to continue using Parsec, or leave this team in your Parsec account settings.

-6023.title: The peer-to-peer network connection between you and the other computer failed
-6023.desc: Something is preventing Parsec from making the connection, check our article for more information.

-6024.title: Failed to connect to Parsec STUN servers
-6024.desc: Something may be blocking your connection to the Parsec STUN server, check our article for more information.

-6101.title: Parsec couldn't communicate with its servers
-6101.desc: Something is preventing Parsec from making a websocket connection to its backend.

-6112.title: IPv6 is disabled or not supported
-6112.desc: Your device must support IPv6 even if you're using IPv4.

-6200.label: Download
-6200.title: The network connection between you and the other computer failed with webRTC
-6200.desc: Please install Parsec on your client which is more likely to work.

-7000.title: OpenGL was unable to be launched
-7000.desc: Make sure your device meets our minimum requirements and is setup correctly.

-7007.title: This device has an incompatible version of OpenGL
-7007.desc: Make sure your device meets our minimum requirements and is setup correctly.

-12007.title: The network connection was lost
-12007.desc: The connection is unreliable, or the other computer has crashed.

-12010.title: The computer you were connected to disappeared
-12010.desc: The computer may have crashed or lost the internet connection.

-13000.title: The computer you're joining is trying to use an unsupported resolution
-13000.desc: Change the resolution to something else on the host computer's Parsec settings.

-13008.title: The computer you're joining is trying to use an unsupported resolution
-13008.desc: Change the resolution to something else on the host computer's Parsec settings.

-13009.title: The host resolution is above our maximum supported resolution of 3840x2160
-13009.desc: Try to lower the resolution of the display on the host computer.

-13012.desc: The host is not allowing any more guests.

-13015.title: Something went wrong with the client device while initializing the stream
-13015.desc: Please check our article for more information.

-14003.title: We were unable to capture the screen of the computer you were attempting to connect to
-14003.desc: Check our article for more information.

-15000.title: The computer you are attempting connect to does not support hardware video encoding
-15000.desc: The host computer may have unsupported hardware or its drivers need an update, check our article for more information.

-15002.title: The host encoder failed
-15002.desc: This could be because on the host either HDR is active, the display resolution is too high, or the graphics driver needs an update.

-15106.title: The host encoder failed
-15106.desc: This could be because on the host either HDR is active, or the display resolution is too high.

-15107.title: The resolution is too high on the host
-15107.desc: Reduce the resolution on the host computer to connect.

-18000.title: Parsec couldn't communicate with its servers
-18000.desc: Check if your internet is working, and if it is, check our article for more information.

-22008.desc: The host could not capture the screen.
